glossary.definition: (A) "Collected plant" means any plant dug or gathered from any wood lot, field, forest, or any other location in which such a plant is found growing in its native habitat.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Collector" means any person who collects, for sale, plants from wood lots, fields, forests, or other native habitat.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition:
(C) "Dealer" means any person other than a nurseryman who offers for sale, sells, or distributes nursery stock, either exclusively or in connection with other merchandise, in or from any nursery, store, sales ground, stand, lot, truck, railway car, or other vehicle. "Dealer" includes any landscaper who sells or offers for sale nursery stock as a part of a grounds improvement project that may involve the installation of such plants.

(D) "Hardy," when applied to plants and bulbs, whether wild or cultivated, means capable of surviving the normal winter temperatures of this state.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Host" means any plant or plant product from which any pest derives its food supply, or upon which it depends for its well being or to complete any part of its life cycle.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Infested" means containing or harboring one or more pests or infected with one or more pests.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition: (G) "Nursery" means any grounds or premises on or in which nursery stock is propagated or grown for sale.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition: (H) "Nurseryman" means a person who owns, leases, manages, or is in charge of a nursery.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition: (J) "Person" means any corporation, company, society, association, partnership, individual or combination of individuals, institution, park, or any public agency administered by the state or any subdivision of the state.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition: (K) "Pest" means any insect, mite, nematode, bacteria, fungus, virus, parasitic plant, or any other organism or any stage of any such organism that causes, or is capable of causing, injury, disease, or damage to any plant, plant part, or plant product.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition: (L) "Place of business" means each separate location from which nursery stock is sold, offered for sale, or distributed.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition: (M) "Intensive production area" means a place where nursery stock is propagated or grown using greenhouses, liner beds, lath beds, or containers.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition: (N) "Nonintensive production area" means any place where nursery stock is propagated or grown as field stock.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.

glossary.definition: (O) "Forced floral plants" means plants with desirable flower characteristics in which the bloom is artificially induced at an unnatural time of the year.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 927.51 to 927.73 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 927.51 - Plants and nursery stock definitions.
